label: Accuracy
help: Hits / (hits + misses). Blocked and Disabled attacks are excluded.

label: Hits
help: Your direct melee damage confirmed by the server within the attack window.

label: Attacks
help: Unique attacks aimed at the opponent. Swings away and duplicates are excluded.

label: Misses
help: Every eligible attack with no damage or shield block, including invulnerability clicks.

label: Average reach
help: Eye to attack-pick contact on confirmed survival hits. Not a server verdict.

label: Maximum reach
help: Largest eye to attack-pick contact on a confirmed survival hit.

label: Critical-hit rate
help: Hits with critical conditions / confirmed hits. Damage is not verified.

label: Sprint-hit rate
help: Hits made while sprinting / confirmed hits. Knockback is not verified.

label: Average hit interval
help: Mean attack-time gap between consecutive confirmed hits.

label: Interval deviation
help: Population standard deviation of hit intervals; lower is more consistent.

label: Jump candidates
help: Actual jumps within the signed client-tick window around incoming damage. Same tick is an ideal candidate; success is unavailable.

label: Longest combo
help: Most consecutive confirmed hits before an attributed return hit, a same-tick trade or a disengagement gap (combo timeout).

label: Average combo
help: Mean length of combos: runs of two or more consecutive confirmed hits.

label: Legacy momentum
help: Older recordings' per-hit value: +0.20 per hit, -0.25 per attributed incoming hit, 3 s decay. Superseded by encounter dominance.

label: Hits taken
help: Only the tracked opponent's direct melee damage. Projectiles and remaining damage are listed by cause.

label: Attacks into a raised shield
help: Attacks made while the target's client-visible state showed an active shield.

label: Blocked attacks
help: Blocked plus Disabled attacks. A block sound or a raised facing shield with no damage counts as blocked.

label: Disabled
help: Attacks followed by a shield-disable sound. Included in blocked attacks, excluded from accuracy.

label: Hits after a disable
help: Confirmed hits within 5 s of a shield disable you caused.

label: Blocked
help: Opponent swings blocked by your raised shield, with no damage.

label: Server critical hits
help: Your confirmed hits with the server's critical-hit animation on the opponent within one tick. Damage is not reported.

label: Combos
help: Runs of two or more consecutive confirmed hits.

label: Hits in combos
help: Confirmed hits that were part of a combo of two or more.

label: Longest opponent combo
help: Consecutive direct melee hits from the tracked opponent.

label: Longest streak
help: Most consecutive confirmed hits before an attributed return hit, ignoring disengagement gaps.

label: Combat advantage
help: Decaying melee hit and shield evidence. Non-melee damage is excluded. Not a win probability.

label: Advantage share
help: Share of active samples at or above +0.2 for you or at or below -0.2 for the opponent. Inactive samples are excluded.

label: Reach in target window
help: Eligible confirmed hits (ray contact) within the configured target and tolerance.

label: Reach consistency
help: Population standard deviation of eligible confirmed-hit reach; lower is more consistent.

label: Average deviation from target
help: Mean absolute difference between eligible hit reach and the configured target.

label: Central aim
help: Hits graded ideal or good by the client hitbox heuristic. Not a damage measure.

label: Distance from ideal point
help: Mean blocks between the recorded contact and the region's ideal point; SD is aim consistency.

label: Cooldown-matched intervals
help: Graded attack intervals within the tick tolerance of the weapon's cooldown. Mechanical readiness, not tactical quality.

label: Health lost
help: Sum of observed decreases of your health plus absorption during the recording.

label: Knockback observed
help: Incoming hits with a server velocity update for you within one tick.

label: Recordings
help: Fights and manual sessions in local history.
